messages:
Elaine (AE): Kicking off the SIG evidence thread for StellarBank POC. They want question-by-question artifacts and a clear mapping to SIG sections. Deadline they've asked for is end of week. Who can own KMS rotation proof and SOC2 redaction?

Mike (SecEng): I can own KMS + IAM bits. Quick clarifying Q: do they want the full key IDs or just screenshots/policies showing rotation policy? They explicitly said 'proof of rotation and retention policy'.

Priya (Solutions): I'll take network diagrams, app config excerpts, and sample log slices. For logs they want retention + access proof — plan to pull CloudTrail S3 path + 3 redacted log lines. Where should I upload artifacts?

Elaine (AE): Use the shared upload bucket: s3://redwood-sig-uploads/stellarbank/. Please add a README.txt that maps each file to the SIG question number. I'll coordinate final handoff to the customer portal.

cd-deploy-bot: Uploaded artifact: kms-rotation-screenshot.png -> s3://redwood-sig-uploads/stellarbank/kms-rotation-screenshot.png

Mike (SecEng): Two quick notes: 1) sanitize any GUIDs/user identifiers in log samples. 2) For CAIQ/runtime isolation questions they asked about container hardening — I'll provide IAM roles + a screenshot of KMS key policy and a short statement about rotation schedule.

Priya (Solutions): Ops confirmed container isolation (gVisor + cgroups) and we have a network diagram. I'm attaching network-diagram-v2.svg to the bucket. Also preparing a secrets-management snippet for the SIG: 
```
# example redacted snippet
client = kms.Client()
cipher = client.encrypt(key="projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/primary", plaintext=b"...")
```

Elaine (AE): Timeline check — can we have the KMS + IAM by Wed noon, diagrams + logs by Thu 5pm PST, final bundle by Thu EOD so I can upload by Fri COB? Customer is pushing for Friday.

Mike (SecEng): I'll finish KMS rotation proof, key policy screenshot, and an IAM role export by Wed 11:30am. I'll also include a short plain‑language note for the auditor: "KMS keys rotated per policy; rotation window 30 days" (redacted key names).

Priya (Solutions): Logs + diagram targeted for Thu 2pm. I'll include sample CloudTrail lines with all PII hashed and a small README explaining redaction rules.

Rafael (Eng-SRE): Chiming in — vulnerability scan ran last week. Summary is at s3://sec-scans/2024-04-08/summary.pdf. I'll copy a redacted summary page into the stellarbank upload bucket by tomorrow.

Elaine (AE): Perfect. I'll QA everything and assemble evidence-index.csv that maps files to SIG question numbers. Plan to create a zip and upload. :thumbsup:

sigbot: Reminder: SIG checklist requires these three root items in the upload root: `evidence-index.csv`, `README.txt`, and per-question mapping files (one file per major SIG section). Missing: `SOC2-report-redacted.pdf`.

Elaine (AE): Noted — who owns SOC2 redaction? We need a redacted copy that removes other customer names and sensitive org charts.

Mike (SecEng): Security ops usually owns SOC2 redaction. I'll ping them now and ask for an ETA.

Priya (Solutions): FYI I put a placeholder file named SOC2-report-redacted.pdf (0 bytes) in the bucket to reserve the filename and avoid upload collisions.

Mike (SecEng): Update: SOC ops replied — redaction ETA is 48 hours, they requested the exact pages to keep. Elaine, can you finalize which sections StellarBank requires so ops can cut the redaction scope?

Elaine (AE): I'll confirm with the customer and post back in this thread within the hour. Also: for the SIG portal submission we need an S3 presigned link per file or a single zip? Customer portal accepts a zip upload. I'll prepare a final zip and a list of filenames.

Rafael (Eng-SRE): Small ops note — when adding scan PDF to the upload bucket please set object ACL to restricted and add a README with contact and proof of redaction.

Priya (Solutions): Will do. Also adding a tiny text file `observability-sample.log.snippet.txt` with 3 redacted lines so they can see retention/access format.

Elaine (AE): Sounds good. If all owners hit their targets we should be able to upload by Thu evening and submit Friday morning. I'll flag blockers here if anything slips. Thanks team.

Mike (SecEng): One final ask — for the SIG question that asks for recorded patch cadence, supply the last 3 monthly patch reports. Rafael can we pull those?

Rafael (Eng-SRE): Yes — patch reports are in s3://infra-reports/patching/2024-03/2024-04/ etc. I'll copy the relevant PDFs into the stellarbank folder and redact hostnames.

Elaine (AE): Excellent. I'll wait for the SOC ops redaction and Rafael's scan/patch artifacts. I'll post back once I kick off the zip. Thanks everyone :rocket:
